channel.title: Index Anomalies // Public Registry of Pseudonymous Artists & Archives
channel.description: A public digital vault and registry dedicated to anonymous and pseudonymous masters, featuring archived profiles and structural records.

item.title: Record [001]: Herida — Sculptural Form & Material Archive
item.description: Registry entry focusing on weight, balance, raw tension, and heavy materials interacting with space outside traditional gallery loops.

item.title: Record [002]: Blank — Public Archive & Conceptual Record
item.description: An ongoing experiment tracking unmanaged public interaction on unmarked paper left in active public thoroughfares.

item.title: Record [006]: 9Fingers — Physical Record & Structural Anomaly
item.description: Baseline structural archive established in New York in 1999, featuring heavy pigment layers and uncompromised temporal permanence.

item.title: Record [008]: Leaves — Wood & Botanical Public Archive
item.description: Physical panels constructed from discarded wood and organic botanical elements sourced directly from urban and natural environments.

item.title: Record [011]: Gold — Monochromatic Abstraction Registry
item.description: A strict series built entirely in gold, examining repetition, value, and subtle variance within a closed systematic framework.
